theme.name: Classic Spooky Halloween
theme.description: Traditional Halloween atmosphere with pumpkins, ghosts, and witches

menu.name: Mummy Hot Dogs with Cheese Bandages
menu.description: Crescent roll-wrapped hot dogs with melted cheese strips to resemble mummy bandages, topped with olive eyes for a classic spooky look
menu.notes: Can be prepared ahead and reheated; highly Instagram-worthy

menu.name: Witch Hat Chocolate Treats
menu.description: Hershey's Kisses glued to chocolate wafer cookies with chocolate frosting and gold star candies on top, creating adorable witch hats
menu.notes: Perfect for dessert or party favors; requires minimal cooking skills

menu.name: Pumpkin Cheese Ball with Crackers
menu.description: Orange-tinted cream cheese and cheddar blend shaped into a pumpkin with a pretzel stem and chive details, served with assorted crackers
menu.notes: Can be made 1-2 days ahead; classic Halloween color scheme

menu.name: Ghost Deviled Eggs with Peppercorn Eyes
menu.description: Traditional deviled eggs decorated to look like friendly ghosts with black peppercorn or olive eyes and a simple ghost face design
menu.notes: Protein-rich option; can be prepared several hours ahead

menu.name: Black Cat Pretzel Snack Mix
menu.description: Black-tinted pretzel mix with chocolate chips, black licorice, and candy eyes scattered throughout in a cauldron-style serving bowl
menu.notes: Budget-friendly; requires no cooking; great for continuous snacking throughout party

menu.name: Spooky Spider Web Dip Platter
menu.description: Black bean dip base with sour cream piped in web patterns, topped with a candy spider, surrounded by orange and black tortilla chips
menu.notes: Visually striking; can be assembled 2 hours before serving; crowd-pleaser

decorations.name: Giant Inflatable Pumpkins & Ghost Display
decorations.description: 6-8 foot tall inflatable pumpkins and ghosts strategically placed around venue entrance and corners. Creates immediate visual impact with classic Halloween imagery. Mix of orange pumpkins and white ghosts with purple LED lighting underneath.
decorations.sourceMethod: Purchase from party supply retailers or Amazon

decorations.name: Witch Hat & Broomstick Pathway Markers
decorations.description: Oversized witch hats (2-3 feet) mounted on poles with accompanying broomsticks lining the pathway to venue. Paint hats in black and purple, add orange accents. DIY-friendly with foam or cardboard bases.
decorations.sourceMethod: DIY with craft supplies or purchase pre-made decorative hats

decorations.name: Illuminated Pumpkin Patch Installation
decorations.description: Cluster of 30-40 real and foam pumpkins in varying sizes arranged in designated area. Add purple and orange string lights woven through arrangement. Carve select pumpkins with LED candles inside for glowing effect.
decorations.sourceMethod: Mix of real pumpkins from local farms/stores and craft foam pumpkins
decorations.visualImpact: Very high - focal point of outdoor space

decorations.name: Hanging Ghost Canopy with Purple Netting
decorations.description: White cheesecloth ghosts suspended from overhead structures (trees, tent poles) with purple tulle netting creating layered canopy effect. Add battery-operated purple LED string lights throughout. Creates atmospheric ceiling treatment.
decorations.sourceMethod: DIY with cheesecloth, tulle fabric, and LED lights from craft stores
decorations.themeAlignment: Ethereal ghost element with color coordination

decorations.name: Witch Silhouette & Cauldron Scene Backdrop
decorations.description: Large black plywood cutouts of witches on broomsticks and cauldrons (4-6 feet tall) positioned against fence or wall. Paint with glow-in-dark paint and backlight with orange/purple spotlights. Photo opportunity area.
decorations.sourceMethod: DIY with plywood, paint, and power tools or commission local artist

decorations.name: Ground-Level Fog Effect with Colored Uplighting
decorations.description: Fog machine creating low-lying mist throughout venue with strategically placed orange and purple LED uplights. Creates eerie, atmospheric ground-level effect that enhances spooky ambiance without overwhelming guests.
decorations.sourceMethod: Rent fog machine from party rental company; purchase LED uplights
decorations.visualImpact: Very high - transforms entire venue ambiance
decorations.notes: Requires power source; ensure guest safety and visibility

playlist.name: Classic Halloween Hits
playlist.description: Mix of Halloween classics and spooky atmosphere tracks
